# GlobeTrek Tourism Package & Travel Booking Management System
> Full-Stack College DBMS PBL Project 63 (3NF Relational Database & MakeMyTrip-inspired Web Application)

## Overview
GlobeTrek is an end-to-end full-stack tourism package and travel booking management platform inspired by MakeMyTrip (MMT). It integrates a normalized relational database in Third Normal Form (3NF) with a Python FastAPI backend and a responsive React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS frontend.

## Key Features
- **Tour Package Discovery**: Search across 50+ worldwide & domestic destinations (India, Europe, Asia, Americas, Middle East, Oceania) with interactive day calendar & budget sliders.
- **Relational Integrity**: 20 normalized database tables, 5 SQL analytical views, and 14 academic SQL reporting queries enforcing foreign keys and business constraints.
- **Overbooking Prevention**: Real-time capacity checks ensuring `booked_seats <= max_capacity`.
- **Guide Conflict Resolution**: Self-join validation preventing overlapping schedule assignments for tour guides.
- **Demo Payment Gateway Simulation**: UPI QR code, Credit/Debit Card, NetBanking, and 1-Click Demo Pay with instant transaction ID generation.
- **Cancellation & Refunds**: Automated cancellation fee calculations (10%, 25%, 50% tiers based on departure notice) with departure seat restoration.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: JWT-secured portals for Customers, Administrators, and Tour Guides.

## Database Schema Highlights (3NF)
1. `Users` - Customer, Admin, Guide authentication
2. `Roles` - System role definitions
3. `UserRoles` - Multi-role junction
4. `Destinations` - Cities, states, regions
5. `Countries` - Worldwide nation registry
6. `PackageCategories` - Standardized tour types
7. `TourPackages` - Main package catalog
8. `PackageItineraries` - Day-by-day itineraries
9. `Hotels` - Verified 3-5 star accommodation
10. `PackageHotels` - Hotel assignment per package
11. `TransportOptions` - Flight, Volvo bus, SUV, coach specs
12. `PackageTransport` - Transit options per package
13. `TourGuides` - Certified local guides & languages
14. `Departures` - Scheduled batches with capacity tracking
15. `Bookings` - Traveller reservations
16. `BookingTravellers` - Individual passenger manifest
17. `Payments` - Transaction history and payment modes
18. `Cancellations` - Cancellation records & reason tracking
19. `Refunds` - Processed refund status and amounts
20. `AuditLogs` - Administrative mutation logs
